ucs.title: [LLM] Silk Typhoon (HAFNIUM) — Exchange/IIS web shell post-exploitation (w3wp.exe spawning shell + discovery binaries)
ucs.description: Hunts the foundational HAFNIUM/Silk Typhoon tradecraft: post-ProxyLogon (CVE-2021-26855/26857/26858/27065) China Chopper-style web shells planted under OWA/ECP/OAB virtual directories, executing through IIS worker processes (w3wp.exe / UMWorkerProcess.exe) and spawning native discovery, credential, and download tooling. Same parent→child shape was seen again in Silk Typhoon's 2023-2025 exploitation of Ivanti Pulse, Citrix NetScaler, and Microsoft Exchange edge devices.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as Cmd values(Processes.parent_process) as ParentCmd values(Processes.user) as User from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("w3wp.exe","UMWorkerProcess.exe","Microsoft.Exchange.Search.Service.exe")) AND (Processes.process_name IN ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","whoami.exe","hostname.exe","systeminfo.exe","nltest.exe","ipconfig.exe","quser.exe","tasklist.exe","schtasks.exe","reg.exe","wmic.exe","csc.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","cscript.exe","wscript.exe","procdump.exe","procdump64.exe","7z.exe","7za.exe")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_path | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | convert ctime(firstTime), ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("w3wp.exe","UMWorkerProcess.exe","Microsoft.Exchange.Search.Service.exe")
| where FileName in~ ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","whoami.exe","hostname.exe","systeminfo.exe","nltest.exe","ipconfig.exe","quser.exe","tasklist.exe","schtasks.exe","reg.exe","wmic.exe","csc.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","cscript.exe","wscript.exe","procdump.exe","procdump64.exe","7z.exe","7za.exe")
| where not(ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Set-OabVirtualDirectory","Get-OwaVirtualDirectory") and InitiatingProcessCommandLine has "ECP")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage  = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where ParentProcessName matches regex @"(?i)\\(w3wp|UMWorkerProcess|Microsoft\.Exchange\.Search\.Service)\.exe$"
| where NewProcessName matches regex @"(?i)\\(cmd|powershell|pwsh|net1?|whoami|hostname|systeminfo|nltest|ipconfig|quser|tasklist|schtasks|reg|wmic|csc|certutil|bitsadmin|mshta|rundll32|regsvr32|cscript|wscript|procdump(64)?|7za?)\.exe$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account, SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, TokenElevationType
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: HAFNIUM/Silk Typhoon Exchange Web Shell Post-Exploitation
id: 8f3a1e62-3d4b-4d51-9c7e-1f1a45a7a212
status: experimental
description: |
  Detects child processes of IIS worker / Exchange unified-messaging worker (w3wp.exe, UMWorkerProcess.exe,
  Microsoft.Exchange.Search.Service.exe) executing native discovery, credential, or LOLBin payload binaries.
  This parent->child pattern is the canonical HAFNIUM (Silk Typhoon, G0125) tradecraft following web shell
  drop via ProxyLogon and successor edge-device exploitation campaigns.
references:
  - https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2021/03/02/hafnium-targeting-exchange-servers/
  - https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2025/03/05/silk-typhoon-targeting-it-supply-chain/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/18
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.t1505.003
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1059.003
  - attack.g0125
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\w3wp.exe'
      - '\UMWorkerProcess.exe'
      - '\Microsoft.Exchange.Search.Service.exe'
  child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\net.exe'
      - '\net1.exe'
      - '\whoami.exe'
      - '\hostname.exe'
      - '\systeminfo.exe'
      - '\nltest.exe'
      - '\ipconfig.exe'
      - '\quser.exe'
      - '\tasklist.exe'
      - '\schtasks.exe'
      - '\reg.exe'
      - '\wmic.exe'
      - '\csc.exe'
      - '\certutil.exe'
      - '\bitsadmin.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\procdump.exe'
      - '\procdump64.exe'
      - '\7z.exe'
      - '\7za.exe'
  condition: parent and child
falsepositives:
  - Exchange admin running Exchange Management Shell scripts via ECP (rare; allowlist by known admin host)
  - Monitoring agents that shell out from IIS worker for health checks
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\\w3wp.exe OR *\\W3WP.exe OR *\\UMWorkerProcess.exe OR *\\UMWORKERPROCESS.EXE OR *\\Microsoft.Exchange.Search.Service.exe) @Image:(*\\cmd.exe OR *\\CMD.EXE OR *\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\net.exe OR *\\NET.EXE OR *\\net1.exe OR *\\whoami.exe OR *\\WHOAMI.EXE OR *\\nltest.exe OR *\\systeminfo.exe OR *\\reg.exe OR *\\REG.EXE OR *\\wmic.exe OR *\\WMIC.EXE OR *\\certutil.exe OR *\\CertUtil.exe OR *\\bitsadmin.exe OR *\\mshta.exe OR *\\MSHTA.EXE OR *\\rundll32.exe OR *\\RunDLL32.exe OR *\\regsvr32.exe OR *\\RegSvr32.exe OR *\\cscript.exe OR *\\wscript.exe OR *\\procdump.exe OR *\\procdump64.exe OR *\\7z.exe OR *\\7za.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/(w3wp|UMWorkerProcess|Microsoft\.Exchange\.Search\.Service)\.exe$/i ImageFileName=/\\(cmd|powershell|pwsh|net1?|whoami|hostname|systeminfo|nltest|ipconfig|quser|tasklist|schtasks|reg|wmic|csc|certutil|bitsadmin|mshta|rundll32|regsvr32|cscript|wscript|procdump(64)?|7za?)\.exe$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, UserName], function=count())
| count > 0
ucs.rationale: w3wp.exe and UMWorkerProcess.exe are Exchange/IIS service hosts — under normal operation they NEVER spawn cmd.exe, net.exe, whoami.exe, procdump, or 7z. This parent->child relationship was the literal IOC pattern Volexity and Microsoft published when HAFNIUM was first attributed in March 2021 (Operation Exchange Marauder), and the same shape resurfaced in 2023-2025 Silk Typhoon supply-chain campai

ucs.title: [LLM] Silk Typhoon — service principal credential addition followed by mailbox/Graph access from new IP (post-MSP-compromise cloud pivot)
ucs.description: Silk Typhoon's 2024-2025 supply-chain playbook: after compromising a downstream IT service provider, MSP, or cloud-management vendor, the actor adds a new client secret or certificate to an existing privileged Entra ID service principal (or app registration), then re-authenticates as that SP from attacker infrastructure to enumerate or exfiltrate Exchange Online / SharePoint / Graph data in the customer tenant. Detects the credential-add → SP sign-in chain when the SP authenticates from an IP that wasn't the actor who added the credential, against Exchange/Graph/SharePoint resources.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as CredAddTime values(Account_Management.user) as CredAdder values(Account_Management.src) as CredAdderIP values(Account_Management.object) as TargetSp from datamodel=Change.Account_Management where (Account_Management.action="updated" OR Account_Management.action="added") (Account_Management.command="Add service principal credentials" OR Account_Management.command="Update application Certificates and secrets management" OR Account_Management.command="Add application Certificates and secrets") by Account_Management.object_id
| rename Account_Management.object_id as TargetSpId
| join type=inner TargetSpId [
  | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as SignInTime values(Authentication.src) as SignInIP values(Authentication.dest) as Resource from datamodel=Authentication where Authentication.signature="service-principal-signin" Authentication.action="success" Authentication.dest IN ("Office 365 Exchange Online","Microsoft Graph","Office 365 SharePoint Online","SharePoint") by Authentication.user_id
  | rename Authentication.user_id as TargetSpId
]
| where SignInTime >= CredAddTime AND SignInTime <= relative_time(CredAddTime, "+24h")
| where CredAdderIP != SignInIP
| eval DelayMinutes = round((SignInTime - CredAddTime)/60, 1)
| convert ctime(CredAddTime), ctime(SignInTime)
| table CredAddTime, SignInTime, DelayMinutes, CredAdder, CredAdderIP, TargetSp, TargetSpId, SignInIP, Resource
| sort - SignInTime
ucs.kql:
let CredAdditions = CloudAppEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where Application == "Office 365"
    | where ActionType in~ ("Add service principal credentials.","Update application  Certificates and secrets management ","Add application Certificates and secrets")
    | extend Initiator = AccountDisplayName, InitiatorIP = IPAddress
    | extend TargetSpName = tostring(ActivityObjects[0].Name), TargetSpId = tostring(ActivityObjects[0].Id)
    | project CredAddTime = Timestamp, Initiator, InitiatorIP, TargetSpName, TargetSpId, ActionType;
let SpAuth = CloudAppEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where ActionType =~ "Sign-in activity"
    | where AccountType == "ServicePrincipal" or AdditionalFields has "ServicePrincipal"
    | extend SpId = AccountObjectId, Resource = tostring(ActivityObjects[0].Name)
    | where Resource in~ ("Office 365 Exchange Online","Microsoft Graph","Office 365 SharePoint Online")
    | project SignInTime = Timestamp, SpId, SignInIP = IPAddress, Resource, City, CountryCode;
CredAdditions
| join kind=inner SpAuth on $left.TargetSpId == $right.SpId
| where SignInTime between (CredAddTime .. CredAddTime + 24h)
| where SignInIP != InitiatorIP
| project CredAddTime, SignInTime,
          DelayMinutes = datetime_diff('minute', SignInTime, CredAddTime),
          Initiator, InitiatorIP, TargetSpName, TargetSpId,
          SignInIP, City, CountryCode, Resource
| order by SignInTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let CorrelationWindow = 24h;
let CredAdditions = AuditLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where OperationName in~ (
        "Add service principal credentials",
        "Update application  Certificates and secrets management ",
        "Update application - Certificates and secrets management",
        "Add application Certificates and secrets")
    | where Result =~ "success"
    | extend InitBy = parse_json(InitiatedBy)
    | extend Initiator = coalesce(tostring(InitBy.user.userPrincipalName), tostring(InitBy.app.displayName))
    | extend InitiatorIP = tostring(InitBy.user.ipAddress)
    | mv-expand TR = TargetResources
    | extend TargetSpName = tostring(TR.displayName), TargetSpId = tostring(TR.id)
    | where isnotempty(TargetSpId)
    | project CredAddTime = TimeGenerated, Initiator, InitiatorIP, TargetSpName, TargetSpId, OperationName;
let SpSignIns = AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ResultType == 0
    | where ResourceDisplayName in~ ("Office 365 Exchange Online","Microsoft Graph","Office 365 SharePoint Online","SharePoint")
    | project SignInTime = TimeGenerated, ServicePrincipalId, ServicePrincipalName, SpSignInIP = IPAddress, ResourceDisplayName, Location;
CredAdditions
| join kind=inner SpSignIns on $left.TargetSpId == $right.ServicePrincipalId
| where SignInTime between (CredAddTime .. CredAddTime + CorrelationWindow)
| where SpSignInIP != InitiatorIP
| project CredAddTime, SignInTime,
          DelayMinutes = datetime_diff('minute', SignInTime, CredAddTime),
          Initiator, InitiatorIP, TargetSpName, TargetSpId,
          SpSignInIP, Location, ResourceDisplayName, OperationName
| order by SignInTime desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:azure.activeDirectory (@evt.name:"Add service principal credentials" OR @evt.name:"Update application  Certificates and secrets management " OR @evt.name:"Add application Certificates and secrets") @evt.outcome:success
